<noinclude>{{SbcHeaderLojbanPod|title=Call Me|id=A0011}}</noinclude>
{{SbcIntroductionLojbanPod}}
In this lesson, Liliana and JP tell us how to say goodbye and a lot of other very useful phrases, such as “right?”, “when?”, “let's see”, “I don't know”, “call me!”, and “OK”. The keyword is one of them: '''llámame''' – call me.
{{SbcSourceLojbanPod|[[Lojban by Choice/LojbanPod newbie lesson A0019|A0019: How do you spell beige?]], [[Lojban by Choice/LojbanPod newbie lesson A0030|A0030: Call back later]], [[Lojban by Choice/LojbanPod newbie lesson A0086|A0086: Are you single?]]}}

{{SbcExercisesLojbanPod}}
<noinclude>====Dialogue Translation====
Translate from Lojban to English. Click each bar to check your answer. If possible, read the Lojban sentences aloud.
{{SbcQuestion
| '''Nos vemos mañana, ¿no?'''
| We see each other tomorrow, right?
| '''¿A qué hora?'''
| At what time?
| '''A ver, no sé. Llámame más tarde.'''
| Let's see. I don't know. Call me later.
| '''Vale. Hasta mañana.'''
| OK, see you tomorrow.
}}</noinclude><includeonly>====Dialogue Translation====
Cover the right column, translate from Lojban to English and uncover the right column line by line to check your answers. If possible, read the Lojban sentences aloud.
{{SbcQuestionPrint
| '''Nos vemos mañana, ¿no?'''
| We see each other tomorrow, right?
| '''¿A qué hora?'''
| At what time?
| '''A ver, no sé. Llámame más tarde.'''
| Let's see. I don't know. Call me later.
| '''Vale. Hasta mañana.'''
| OK, see you tomorrow.
}}</includeonly>
<noinclude>====Dialogue Recall====
Now translate from English to Lojban. Remember to say the Lojban sentences aloud.
{{SbcQuestion
| We see each other tomorrow, right? | '''Nos vemos mañana, ¿no?'''
| At what time? | '''¿A qué hora?''' 
| Let's see. I don't know. Call me later. | '''A ver, no sé. Llámame más tarde.'''
| OK, see you tomorrow. | '''Vale. Hasta mañana.'''
}}</noinclude><includeonly>====Dialogue Recall====
Now translate from English to Lojban. Remember to say the Lojban sentences aloud.
{{SbcQuestionPrint
| We see each other tomorrow, right? | '''Nos vemos mañana, ¿no?'''
| At what time? | '''¿A qué hora?''' 
| Let's see. I don't know. Call me later. | '''A ver, no sé. Llámame más tarde.'''
| OK, see you tomorrow. | '''Vale. Hasta mañana.'''
}}</includeonly>
<noinclude>====Dialogue Remix====
Translate this variant of the dialogue from English to Lojban.
{{SbcQuestion
| When do we see each other?
| '''¿A qué hora nos vemos?'''
| Let's see. We see each other tomorrow.
| '''A ver. Nos vemos mañana.
| At what time?
| '''¿A qué hora?'''
| I don't know.
| '''No sé.'''
| OK. Call me.
| '''Vale. Llámame.'''
| OK. When?
| '''Vale. ¿A qué hora?'''
| I don't know! Later!
| '''¡No sé! ¡Más tarde!'''
| Tomorrow?
| '''¿Mañana?'''
| No!
| ¡No!
}}</noinclude><includeonly>====Dialogue Remix====
Translate this variant of the dialogue from English to Lojban.
{{SbcQuestionPrint
| When do we see each other?
| '''¿A qué hora nos vemos?'''
| Let's see. We see each other tomorrow.
| '''A ver. Nos vemos mañana.
| At what time?
| '''¿A qué hora?'''
| I don't know.
| '''No sé.'''
| OK. Call me.
| '''Vale. Llámame.'''
| OK. When?
| '''Vale. ¿A qué hora?'''
| I don't know! Later!
| '''¡No sé! ¡Más tarde!'''
| Tomorrow?
| '''¿Mañana?'''
| No!
| '''¡No!'''
}}</includeonly>
<noinclude>====Dialogue Recast====
This translation exercise requires some of the words from the [[#More Vocabulary|More Vocabulary]] section.
{{SbcQuestion
| They see each other tomorrow, right? | '''Se ven mañana, ¿no?'''
| At what time? | '''¿A qué hora?''' 
| Let's see. They don't know. Call me later. (formal) | '''A ver, no saben. Llámeme más tarde.'''
| OK, see you tomorrow. | '''Vale. Hasta mañana.'''
}}</noinclude><includeonly>====Dialogue Recast====
This translation exercise requires some of the words from the More Vocabulary section.
